notes.title: Update Juli
notes.notes: Currently we are working on the optimization of the gameplay and fixing bugs. In addition, some text still needs to be translated. The final version will be released in French as well. Trading cards and achievements have to be implemented too. In September, we want to be complete with these tasks and publish the complete game.

notes.title: Short update on the state of development
notes.notes:
In the last two months we have been working on the missing two chapters. Many new 3D models were created for the vaults under the house. Now there is a need for a lot of fine tuning.
We are also working on fixing the bugs reported by you and your desired improvements. Thanks again for your help.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
First, thanks to everyone for playing our game. Thank you for your suggestions and bug reports.

In update 0.5.1 we have fixed many of the reported bugs. The most serious error was certainly the "Inventory Bug". We have made some changes and believe that this bug was eliminated. Unfortunately we cannot check on our computers because this error never occurred to us. Any feedback on this issue is greatly appreciated.

Release Notes:

Inventory Bug fixed
Dot in the initial logo removed
Missing or incorrect item descriptions updated / corrected
Left statue lacking mesh on the bottom
Invisible walls in the upstairs hallway, right part removed
Menu sound made quieter
Map with coordinates made brighter
Steps sound during jump disabled
Corrections in Russian translation (Credits to the Tolma4Team)


Cheers
TripleBrick
